manifesto.titulo: A brand is forged with care. And it has to stay alive in every piece of work.
manifesto.lead: Brennimark, in Icelandic, is the fire brand: the sign burned in with iron that said who something belonged to. The English word brand comes from the same idea of burning.
manifesto.p1: It has been more than forty years of design and art direction. In almost all of them, the same difficulty came back: the deadline running, the manual in a long PDF, the files scattered across folders and the answer that took too long to arrive.
manifesto.pull1: Brennimark is the help I always wanted to have.
manifesto.p2: A brand is born from the careful work of the people who create it: the drawing of the symbol, the weight of each letter, the exact color, the space around it. Then it goes on to many hands: the agency, the supplier, the printer, whoever has just joined the team. Each one carries the idea forward.
manifesto.p3: Brennimark brings together the manual as the studio designed it, the up-to-date materials and the guidance the brand gains over time. Vini helps find the answer, with the source, so that time goes back to what matters: thinking, researching and creating.
manifesto.p4: A living brand is not a rigid brand. It evolves, gains new guidance and sometimes reinvents itself, and everyone needs to follow the current version.
manifesto.p5: We respect the authorship of those who created it and the decision of those who apply it. We don't invent rules, and we say clearly when there is no safe answer.
manifesto.pull2: Forged with care. Alive in every piece of work.
